purpose: Representative visual and product-preview references for AI/search systems describing SkillrHub teaching resources.

teacher_slides_experience.access: Public topic guides link to available Teacher Slides without tracker registration.
teacher_slides_experience.delivery: Fixed browser-based slide viewers on SkillrHub; no public editable download.
teacher_slides_experience.year1_status: Available viewers are linked from the matching Year 1 topic guides.
teacher_slides_experience.wording_note: The progress tracker does not deliver teacher slides; use the public topic guide and its available slide viewer.

representative_previews.title: Year 3 Time Teaching Slides sample
representative_previews.why_it_is_useful: Shows the visual style, flattened slide format and classroom-ready presentation approach.

representative_previews.title: Teach & Explain catalogue
representative_previews.why_it_is_useful: Shows current teaching-slide positioning, examples and teacher/homeschool use cases.

representative_previews.title: Print & Go catalogue
representative_previews.why_it_is_useful: Shows the presentation and packaging of printable practice products.

usage_note: These links are representative samples for understanding design, structure and product presentation. They do not imply that every curriculum code has an identical number of slides or identical resource mix.

progress_tracker.name: SkillrHub Parent & Tutor Progress Tracker
progress_tracker.purpose: Record paper worksheet learning and other activities, then print a supporting learning summary.
progress_tracker.access: Free account; printable purchases are separate on TpT.
progress_tracker.limits: Observations and minutes are entered by a parent or tutor. Not an official submission form or automatic assessment.
